enunciado: Turn "  hola   mundo de  invenio " into "Hola Mundo De Invenio": remove extra spaces and capitalize the first letter of each word. Also show how many words there are.
objetivos: Detect where words start and end
Use a state flag (inside/outside a word)
pistas: A word starts when you see a letter while outside a word.
Before each word, except the first, add a single space.
to_upper on a single character converts it.
